testo:
■ You may put a non-evolution Jokers creature that costs 4 or less from your hand into the battle zone.
■ Rainbownus: If you have a multicolored creature in the battle zone, you may choose one of your creatures and one of your opponent's creatures. Those 2 creatures battle.

■ レインボーナス：バトルゾーンに自分の多色クリーチャーがあれば、相手と自分のクリーチャーを1体ずつ選んでもよい。その2体をバトルさせる。
